headline: Interim Gold
caption:
UPDATE: With Islam Makhachev out, Carlos Prates now fights unbeaten Michael Morales for the interim UFC welterweight title.
Prates or Morales? 👇

The UFC made it official during the UFC 333 broadcast: the fight lands at UFC 336 on January 30 in Toronto, with Joshua Van defending the flyweight title against Manel Kape on the same card. Dana White says Makhachev gave no reason for missing January.

🔥 Hot take: Whoever wins this is a real problem for Makhachev.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
